user_decision.question: Where should PR #8's re-keyed carrying table live -- in a shared non-private module both tactic families import, or in a register_lcarry environment-extension registry mirroring the merged view table? The draft asks the contributor for the shared module and names the registry alternative once so he can push back.
options: (a) A shared non-private module, e.g. FormalSystem/Automation/ProofMode/Carrying.lean, imported by Temporal.lean and Discrete.lean -- cheapest, a key change plus a file move, and the scope-core records add rows one line at a time

(b) A register_lcarry registry mirroring FormalSystem/Tactic/FormulaViews.lean's SimplePersistentEnvExtension -- lets the scope-core records add rows without touching any Temporal-family file at all, but the registration command must do its own checking since extension rows are invisible to the kernel and to #print axioms
user_decision.recommended: (a) A shared non-private module, e.g. FormalSystem/Automation/ProofMode/Carrying.lean, imported by Temporal.lean and Discrete.lean -- cheapest, a key change plus a file move, and the scope-core records add rows one line at a time
